$comment: Small teams: under 50 employees, knowledge work. Every threshold is a number, every drop has a reason, one person owns the stop.

gates.reason: no primary domain — nothing to enrich against
outside the size band — this profile is for teams under 50
fit below threshold — recorded, not bought

checks.$comment: Judgement per row, folded into the fit score. If a criterion cannot be a filter, it is a check — and a check runs before any expensive step.
checks.product_not_services: is a product company, not a consultancy/agency
checks.gtm_owner_present: a founder or first commercial hire owns the funnel
checks.activity_12mo: dated activity in the last 12 months

tiers.$comment: In this segment the signal does more work than the fit: a 12-person company that just raised is a different company next quarter.

A.rule: fit >= 0.60 AND a signal within 120 days

C.rule: qualified, keep warm — nothing until a signal moves it
